item.title: Inside Visa's quest to go beyond card swipes
item.description: Andrew Torre, the card network's president of Value-Added Services, said demand for security, agentic commerce and better processing are creating demand for technology and consulting.

item.title: How the New York Stock Exchange deploys Anthropic's Claude
item.description: The stock exchange is using the artificial intelligence extensively throughout the organization, including in development of a distributed ledger for tokenized securities.

item.title: Fincen seeking advisors for panel on modernizing AML
item.description: Banks, trade groups and regulators are eligible to join a group convened by Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, or Fincen, which will weigh in on anti-money-laundering rules, Bank Secrecy Act modernization and implementation of a recently passed stablecoin bill.

item.title: Why banks see opportunity in advising art collectors
item.description: After a long price correction in the art market, Bank of America is expanding its advisory services for collectors — and it's not alone.

item.title: What Stripe would get by acquiring PayPal
item.description: There's speculation about a potential deal, which could boost Stripe's merchant appeal and accelerate its agentic commerce strategy. But payment experts also say Stripe could face a bidding war that includes AI companies.

item.title: Anthropic's AI tool sparks cybersecurity panic
item.description: Cybersecurity stocks tumbled after Anthropic unveiled a new vulnerability scanner, prompting vendors to defend their runtime protection platforms.

item.title: BMO says it's finishing US reset, set to resume loan growth
item.description: BMO moved closer to hitting company-wide and U.S. profit targets after reporting increased first-quarter profits.

item.title: Stablecoins draw attention, but are still a tiny market
item.description: In this week's American Banker global payments and fintech roundup, Revolut, Tether and Circle made announcements designed to improve their standing in the stablecoin market. That comes amid new research from McKinsey that says the digital asset is growing quickly, but has not made even a small dent in payments.

item.title: WisdomTree gets SEC approval for 24/7 trading
item.description: The investment broker announced a real-time trading and settlement option for its tokenized money market fund through USDC stablecoins and the ethereum ledger.

item.title: How Santander plans to avoid US 'graveyard' for European banks
item.description: At an investor day in London, Banco Santander executives laid out the Spanish company's new financial goals, including a goal to improve a key profitability metric in the U.S. The pending acquisition of Webster Financial in Connecticut is part of the strategy to achieve higher returns, they said.
